phases.objective: Provide a label-gated, exact-head, read-only dispatcher that can run from trusted pull-request metadata on main and delegates bounded generated-artifact mutation to the already registered workflow without checking out candidate code or writing repository contents directly.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A trusted pull_request_target label or synchronize event, a governed work-branch push, or an explicit workflow dispatch
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The dispatcher resolves exactly one same-repository pull request, requires the generated-artifact-refresh label and exact current head, delegates to governed-generated-artifact-refresh.yml with typed confirmation, and publishes a structured decision without checking out candidate code or writing repository contents directly.
steps: Receive trusted pull-request metadata from the default-branch workflow or resolve a governed work-branch push.
Reject cross-repository heads before any delegated dispatch.
Validate the governed target branch and exact 40-character head SHA.
Resolve exactly one open same-repository pull request for the target branch.
Require the generated-artifact-refresh label and matching pull-request head.
Dispatch the registered mutating workflow on main with target_ref, expected_head_sha, and APPLY_GENERATED_ARTIFACT_REFRESH.
Publish JSON and Markdown evidence before enforcing the structured decision.
assertions: The dispatcher supports pull_request_target types labeled, synchronize, and reopened from the workflow stored on main.
The dispatcher never checks out pull-request candidate code.
The dispatcher rejects fork or cross-repository heads both in the job guard and API readback.
The dispatcher has actions: write but contents: read and pull-requests: read only.
The dispatcher contains no git push and performs no direct repository mutation.
main and Production are rejected before API dispatch.
Bot-authored generated commits do not recursively dispatch.
Job logs are diagnostic-only and the report declares consult_job_logs=false and secrets_included=false.

phases.objective: Publish dispatch evidence through the canonical PR evidence publisher.
Exercise stale-head, API rejection, ambiguous PR, cross-repository, and artifact upload failures.
Observe the first non-production label-gated exact-head dispatch from trusted PR metadata.
Keep protected branches and untrusted candidate code outside direct mutation authority.
